### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **7** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx`  _(via getPublicConfig (symbol, a method of class AuthManager))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES (symbol, a top-level const object), cloudManaged (symbol, a field of const object PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **148** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9dc1f42d50b2ee0c0afe8b6b7d7922b7c912f83a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `9c89cf5b79d343fbeec9d7bfd99fcc8476fa1a03` — the merge of head `72cea5b1ef8d645b9b5e004fd95037e39e021f09` into base `9dc1f42d50b2ee0c0afe8b6b7d7922b7c912f83a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 9c89cf5b79d343fbeec9d7bfd99fcc8476fa1a03 && git checkout 9c89cf5b79d343fbeec9d7bfd99fcc8476fa1a03
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 9dc1f42d50b2ee0c0afe8b6b7d7922b7c912f83a 72cea5b1ef8d645b9b5e004fd95037e39e021f09 && git checkout -B drift-repro 9dc1f42d50b2ee0c0afe8b6b7d7922b7c912f83a && git merge --no-ff 72cea5b1ef8d645b9b5e004fd95037e39e021f09

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9dc1f42d50b2ee0c0afe8b6b7d7922b7c912f83a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 9dc1f42d50b2ee0c0afe8b6b7d7922b7c912f83a` → pass the list as

**engine seat 2 · platform-objects hunk · PASS** · `session_01FaVyM6YvQLg9CsjPVCYc5K` · 2026-10-22T23:01Z · head `d30caab47b` · ruling 6352436010 item 8. Checked: each of the six `visible` (four `invite_user` mirrors, `create_user`, `set_user_password`) hand-writes `features.cloudManaged != true`, and every `requiresFeature` still names one flag (`organization` / `admin`). The lowered rows pin `((MANAGED) && INVITE) && ORG` and `(STANDING && MANAGED) && features.admin == true`. The forward guard replaces `=== gate || endsWith('&& gate')` with a depth-0 `&&` conjunct match that stops at `||` / `?:` / `!( )` and at string literals; its pins accept `gate`, `(a) && gate`, `(a && gate) && b` and reject `a || gate`. I also ran the matcher on its own against 12 cases, including `(x || gate) && y` → false and `(a || b) && gate` → true, and all 12 agree. `set_user_password` is hidden in the console only: this hunk has no server-side refusal, and the registry note says the same. Scope: this line covers platform-objects only; the plugin-auth served row and the spec half are not part of it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `72cea5b1ef8d645b9b5e004fd95037e39e021f09`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts + packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.test.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/action.test.ts, packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json, packages/platform-objects/src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-member.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-invitation.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/platform-objects.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/public-feature-registry.test.ts, packages/core/src/stack-auth.ts (on main, #25294), packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts (on main), .changeset/25292-features-cloud-managed.md, .changeset/25292-cloud-managed-hidden-doors.md, .changeset/25292-plugin-auth-serves-cloud-managed.md, content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx

Inputs: card #25292 (body; comments 6351958701 claim, 6352436010 ruling A, 6352529197 claim amendment, 6353227863 supplement, 6354907704 os-dev-report), governing ruling 6341690661 on #25083 (Q3 A, Q4 A, Q2 D), card #25295 (body; 6352506874 pointer, 6353249248 claim), PR #25309 body, its 22-file list, the net diff against `main` at the head, the engine seat's PASS line 6353213686 (head `d30caab47b`), and the head's check-runs: 42 success, 12 skipped, 0 failure (Test Core 1–6, Build Core, Build Docs, every Lint and Type Check lane, Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, The card this PR closes must claim this branch, No other open PR may claim the same issue, Part-of PR must not also close its card — all success).

Precondition of ruling A (#25294 on `main` before the served line): holds. `db1c7ccad` (feat(core): isCloudManaged(), #25306) is an ancestor of `origin/main` and of the PR's merge-base `21a25dd9`; the branch merged `main` at `840a8ad` and added the served line after it (`91d3cd6`, `72cea5b1`) — no stacking off #25294's branch. `packages/core/src/stack-auth.ts:172` exports `isCloudManaged()` and `:183` `resetCloudManagedForTesting()`, both on `main`.

### ① Derived judgments

Spec half (the hits), each read against ruling 6341690661 Q3 A and ruling 6352436010 items 1–6:

1. `public-auth-features.ts:64` — `PublicAuthFeatureSemantics` gains `'hide-when-on'`. A public type widening of an already-exported union; `api-surface/kernel.json` lists the same export and is unchanged. **Right.**
2. `public-auth-features.ts:336-350` — `FEATURE_GATE_OPERATORS` is a total `satisfies Record` map over the three semantics; `featureGatePredicate('cloudManaged')` returns `features.cloudManaged != true`, and `opt-in` / `default-on` keep `== true` / `!= false` byte-identically (pinned at `public-auth-features.test.ts:76-88`). Exactly the predicate the ruling binds. **Right.**
3. `public-auth-features.ts:237-258` — `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.cloudManaged` (`surface: 'crud'`, `semantics: 'hide-when-on'`), six `gatedInputs`: `invite_user` on `sys_user` / `sys_member` / `sys_invitation` / `sys_organization`, `sys_user.actions.create_user`, `sys_user.actions.set_user_password`. The list the ruling re-verified and #25295's Wanted names. Through `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURE_NAMES` (`:275`) the `requiresFeature` enum on `ActionSchema` (`action.zod.ts:1498`) and `ActionParamSchema` (`:458`) now accepts `'cloudManaged'` and lowers it to `features.cloudManaged != true` (pinned `action.test.ts:185-194`). This is the one accept-set widening and the `Metadata-protocol: added`. **Right.** `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES_NOT_ADVERTISED` untouched, no `exempt` entry, no `gatedInputs: []` interim shape — ruling item 9 (C) not taken. **Right.**
4. `auth-endpoints.zod.ts:242-244` — `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema.cloudManaged: z.boolean().optional()`, the form of `ssoEnforced` / `phoneNumber` / `phoneNumberOtp`. Optional, so every payload accepted before still parses; `.describe()` says absent means not managed, which is the hide-when-on reading. `authorable-surface/api.json:209` gains `api/AuthFeaturesConfig:cloudManaged` in sorted position; the two generated reference pages carry the row and the 12-member enum; `check:generated` is inside the green Lint lane. **Right.**
5. The spec test count moves 11 → 12 (`public-auth-features.test.ts:19-20`) with `cloudManaged` in the sorted name list. **Right.**

Files the spec hunks make a claim about (a rule and its gate read as one):

6. `feature-gate-guard.test.ts:61-128` (matcher) and `:157-165` (forward row), pins at `:168-188` — the forward row now asks `carriesGateConjunct(visibleSource, gate)`: depth-0 split on `&&` outside parentheses, brackets and string literals; wrapping parentheses stripped; a top-level `||` or `?` makes the group opaque; `!(gate)` is not wrapped so stays opaque; membership is `conjunct === gate`, no substring. The two shapes accepted before (`gate`; `X && gate`) still pass; `a || b && gate`, which the old `endsWith('&& gate')` would have accepted, is now refused — correct under CEL precedence and exactly ruling item 3. Pinned: `gate`, `(a) && gate`, `(a && gate) && b`, the four-mirror invite shape; refused `a || gate`, `a || b && gate`, `!(gate)`, `a ? gate : true`, a longer token, the gate inside a string. The reverse row is unchanged, so the six new `features.cloudManaged` references must be booked — they are. A gate taught a shape, not loosened. **Right.**
7. The six predicates — `sys-user.object.ts:106` / `:250` / `:325`, `sys-member.object.ts:109`, `sys-invitation.object.ts:73`, `sys-organization.object.ts:177`: each keeps its single `requiresFeature` (`organization` ×4, `admin` ×2) and gains the literal `features.cloudManaged != true` in `visible` — the four invite mirrors as the whole authored `visible`, `create_user` / `set_user_password` appended with `&&` to the standing term, nothing else in the predicate changed. Lowered bytes pinned at `platform-objects.test.ts:706-707,710,728,744` and `invite-entry-toolbar.test.ts:177-179`; evaluated through `@objectstack/formula`'s `celEngine` at `cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts:65-77` (true hides all six, false offers all six, the other flag off still hides). `set_user_password` is console-only — no server refusal in this diff (Q4 A). **Right.** `requiresFeature` stays single-flag (ruling item 4). **Right.**
8. `auth-manager.ts:49` import and `:8014-8017` `cloudManaged: isCloudManaged()` in the `features` literal — exactly one served line plus its import; nothing else of #25083's services half moves. The existing drift guard (`public-feature-registry.test.ts:41-45` key-set equality; `:84-96` default — a non-`default-on` flag serves `false`, and under vitest `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED` is unset) is the pin ruling item 5 names and is green. The fuse of Q2 D fires inside `isCloudManaged()` on a production boot with no control plane; the served line inherits that behaviour rather than adding a second judgement. **Right.**
9. Public-surface effect on the console: the six lowered predicates change bytes, but they evaluate identically to today wherever the server serves `cloudManaged: false` (every deployment without `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1`), and `cloudManaged: true` was not a reachable state before this PR. The server-side accept set is unchanged. No `(narrowing)` arm anywhere. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/spec` **minor** (`.changeset/25292-features-cloud-managed.md`): `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added` — a new accepted enum value on `requiresFeature` and a new key on a published response schema; `added` takes at least `minor` (AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3). Matches the diff and ruling item 6. **Right.**
- `@objectstack/platform-objects` **patch** (`25292-cloud-managed-hidden-doors.md`): `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` — no authorable key, value or type changes; the accept set does not move; `none` takes `patch`. Matches the diff and the #25295 claim. **Right.**
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth` **patch** (`25292-plugin-auth-serves-cloud-managed.md`): `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none` — the wire payload gains a boolean key (public surface widens; nothing an author writes changes); a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. Matches the diff and ruling item 6's expectation. **Right.**
- No `skip-changeset`; one changeset per package the diff moves; `Check Changeset` success on the head.
- Clause-②: the PR body's line-initial `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added` are the whole-PR declarations the ruling fixed (several kinds ⇒ `added` over `none`), and each changeset carries its own pair. **Right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Maintainer 追认 of ruling 6352436010 is still pending.** This record judges the diff against the ruling as written; ruling item 8 keeps the PR draft until the 追认 reaches the review thread or the card, and the queue waits on it. Not a verdict matter.
2. **Engine seat's read** (6353213686) was on head `d30caab47b`; `git diff d30caab4 72cea5b1 -- packages/platform-objects` is empty, so the PASS covers the platform-objects hunks of this head byte-for-byte. Answered.
3. **Dev open_question (PR body replacement).** Answered by the seat before this read: the body at this reading carries the Verification section at `72cea5b1`, the Services line section, no `Blocked-by:` line and no two-red window; `Fixes #25292`, `Fixes #25295`, `Part of #25083` and both declaration lines are line-initial. Nothing left to patch.
4. **Dev finding: "absent flag fails open".** `public-auth-features.ts:59-62` and `:343-346` (and the test title at `public-auth-features.test.ts:86`, and the spec changeset's "visible when it is off or not served at all") say an absent `cloudManaged` keeps the input visible. `cel-engine.ts:1877` grades `no_such_key` a runtime (data) fault, so `features.cloudManaged != true` on a payload without the key faults and the outcome is the consumer's fault handling — which is why `platform-admin-affordance-standing.test.ts:172` has to serve `cloudManaged: false` and why `cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts:11-14` pins `false`, not absent. The same sentence has stood on `default-on` since #2874; the predicate the ruling binds is exact; the drift guard means a current server never omits a registered flag; and the schema's own `.describe()` ("absent means not managed") is a payload statement that objectui's hand-written readers honour. Not a contract defect of this diff. Escalated to the adopting seat as a follow-up card for the three sentences (or a one-clause trim of the changeset line before landing); #25295's Acceptance wording "false or absent" is met for `false` and is not achievable at the engine for absent on any flag.
5. **Stale jsdoc, in scope.** `action.zod.ts:452` and `:1494` still enumerate only `== true` (opt-in) and `!= false` (default-on). The claim amendment's surface included spec-side readers that must learn the third arm; these are prose on the enum's own schema, not code, and the published page (`content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx:370`) was updated. Flagged for the adopting seat: fold the two comment lines before landing or leave to the follow-up in item 4; not a verdict matter.
6. **One test beyond the allocated surface.** `auth-manager.test.ts:3186-3187` (the exact-match payload gains `cloudManaged: false`) was forced — the suite was red without it. `:3196-3211` adds a "true when `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1`" case; ruling item 5 placed the "true when managed" pins with the services half (`6349623693`). Additive, correct (vitest runs under `NODE_ENV=test`, so the fuse does not fire; the env and memo are restored), and named in the PR body, so the services seat is told; the only cost is a possible textual overlap when that branch merges `main`. Noted, not a breach of the contract.
7. **Dev finding: docs drift `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx`.** Read: line 353 gives an abbreviated example and names "additional `features` keys such as …"; no page enumerates every key. No doc change owed. Agreed.
8. **objectui.** No consumer there imports `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURE_NAMES` or `PublicAuthFeatureSemantics` (its `features` type at `packages/auth/src/types.ts:282` is hand-written), so the widened enum cannot break the pinned console; the objectui half (Setup → Users copy, the reminder) is its own card under #25083. Console Pin Gate was skipped by path filter; nothing here needed it.
9. **Lanes.** The 跨域例外路径 is on record: claim amendment 6352529197 on #25292 and, per supplement 6353227863, claim 6353249248 on #25295 (branch `claude/project-thread-4kg5av`); `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` is success on this head. The PR title names spec and platform-objects only; the body names the plugin-auth line. Cosmetic.

The rest of the diff (the generated reference pages, `api.json`, the test-fixture updates) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.
